root_cause: Adding the completion-receipt API to memory-core/src/memory/completion.rs pushed it to 581 lines and the new tests pushed memory-cli/src/commands/episode/core/complete.rs to 624, both above the 500-LOC ceiling. This is the second firing of the same class in one sprint: the first (server_impl/oauth.rs 984, jsonrpc.rs 548) reached main because no PR workflow ran check-loc.sh; that gap was closed in #1103 by running the sensor in File Structure Validation.
guide_updated: HARNESS.md#feedback-sensors (existing loc row already points at scripts/check-loc.sh; the CI enforcement added in #1103 is the durable fix and made this second firing a pre-merge catch instead of a release-gate surprise)
resolution: Split the in-file test modules into sibling *_tests.rs files declared with #[path] (completion.rs 490 -> durable_write_queue.rs moved method; complete.rs 624 -> 257 + complete_tests.rs 369 non-blocking). check-loc.sh passes; CI caught the violation on the PR before merge, which is the intended behaviour after #1103.
